**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king is exposed and pieces aren't protecting each other well, look for forcing moves (checks and captures). Here, Qd5+ forced the king to move and exposed the undefended rook to capture. Always scan for checks that drive the king into worse positions—they often win material!
